design: Paired sensitivity analysis of a fixed five-percentage-point safety margin
unit_for_uncertainty: independent replication; each replication contains 80 test contexts
primary_metric: returned action with population conditional target-attainment probability >= 0.90, divided by all attempted test contexts
profit_metric: total true expected profit on truly feasible returns divided by constrained oracle total true expected profit on the same contexts
paired_cost_metric: profit difference between fitted risk levels on identical fresh contexts on which both decisions meet the true 0.90 requirement
